records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade Animal rescue incidents attended by LFB dataset. The resource covers January 2009 through July 2026 and includes location information such as postcode, borough and ward. This batch binds verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused public-safety source window; Campden row extraction, geometry and parcel spatial join remain deferred to local OpenCode.
